title: Study-Strategy Clusters from EdNet Logs Track Engagement, Not Mastery
abstract: arXiv:2608.16963v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning analytics often treats unsupervised clusters of intelligent tutoring system (ITS) logs as learner types that should predict learning. We test that assumption on EdNet-KT3. Clustering study-strategy features (resource use, revision, video, problem practice) for 5{,}000 active learners yields a silhouette-selected parent cut ($k=5$) with 4 contrast poles (reading-focused, video-heavy, revision-heavy, and problem-first) plus a large near-mean residual ($\sim$64.9\%). Reclustering that residual adds four finer styles, giving a bootstrap-stable hierarchy of 8 named strategies. We split each learner's timeline by respond count so clusters use only the early half and outcomes only the late half. translated_title: 基于EdNet日志的学习策略聚类：追踪参与度而非掌握度
translated_abstract: 摘要：学习分析通常将智能辅导系统（ITS）日志的无监督聚类视为应能预测学习的学习者类型。我们在EdNet-KT3上检验了这一假设。对5，000名活跃学习者的学习策略特征（资源使用、复习、视频、问题练习）进行聚类，得到一个基于轮廓系数选择的父级划分（k=5），包含4个对比极（阅读为主、视频为主、复习为主和问题优先）以及一个接近均值的较大残差类（约64.9%）。对该残差类重新聚类，增加了四种更精细的风格，形成具有自举稳定性的8种命名策略层级。我们按响应计数将每个学习者的时间线分割，使聚类仅使用前半部分，结果仅使用后半部分。早期聚类能预测后期参与度（继续练习和完成后期会话，尤其是持续性，η²≈0.106；完成度η²≈0.021），但不能预测后期无辅助准确性（后期首次尝试的正确性）。
tldr: 该论文发现基于学习策略的聚类能预测学生的参与度，但无法预测实际的学习掌握度，挑战了学习分析中聚类结果应预测学习效果的常见假设。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that clusters based on study strategies predict student engagement but not actual mastery, challenging the common assumption in learning analytics that clustering results should predict learning outcomes.
